content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Platforms like Gumroad and Payhip charge hefty fees, 10% on every sale, which can be a significant burden on creators. In contrast, NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5% on every transaction, providing a substantial saving for creators. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains a whopping $921, making it a compelling reason to adopt this infrastructure.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a few essential tools. Firstly, you'll need a website hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, you'll need a backend logic platform, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Additionally, you'll need a storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, and a file delivery platform, like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Lastly, you'll need a cryptocurrency payment gateway, like NOWPayments, which integrates seamlessly with your stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack using NOWPayments and other free and open-source tools can save you up to 99.5% in platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question on your mind is probably: 'How do I sell digital products with crypto without relying on Stripe or other platform giants?' The answer is simple: deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack using NOWPayments and other free and open-source tools. This infrastructure setup and deployment will enable you to sell digital products directly to your customers using cryptocurrencies like USDT or Bitcoin, without incurring high platform fees.
Creating a comprehensive sovereign digital commerce stack using the Complete Builder Kit can take your sales and revenue to the next level.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on how to sell digital products with crypto, you can also check out our Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, enabling you to create a comprehensive sovereign digital commerce stack. Additionally, you can visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about our products and services.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: configure your NOWPayments account to accept cryptocurrency payments; integrate your payment gateway with your website hosting platform and backend logic platform; deploy your stack on a website hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; configure your storage solution, like Supabase or Google Sheets; and test your payment and delivery pipeline by making a dummy payment. Once confirmed, you're ready to start selling your digital products to your customers.
